META_DESCRIPTION: Try the FastComments Live Polls demo. Attach a poll to any comment and watch the results update in real time as your community votes.
HERO_DESCRIPTION: Ask your community a question right in the comments. Try the live poll below.
INTRO_TEXT: Vote on the poll below, or click the poll button in the comment toolbar to post your own. Open this page in another tab and watch the results update as votes come in.
OUTRO_TEXT: Polls are built into the FastComments comment widget. Turn on Enable Polls in your widget customization settings, then choose who can create polls and whether voting requires logging in.
ACTION_TEXT: No Credit Card Required For Initial Sign up & Installation
